content:
One of the best AI-powered transcription apps on Mac just got even better, introducing a redesigned transcription editor and significant performance improvements in a major update. Here are the details.

MacWhisper 14 officially released

For those unfamiliar with MacWhisper, it is an excellent app launched by prolific indie developer Jordi Bruin.

It allows users to leverage locally-run AI models on Mac to quickly and easily transcribe audio, video, meetings, and system audio, including OpenAI's Whisper and Nvidia's blazing-fast Parakeet.

I use it daily for parts of my workflow before and after podcast production, and I cannot praise it enough.

Since the launch of MacWhisper in 2023, Bruin has continuously expanded its features, streamlined the workflow, and delivered delightful performance improvements.

MacWhisper 14 continues in that direction, bringing a redesigned editor, faster performance, and a number of other tweaks.

Here's Bruin's share on this update:

Bruin says that based on early feedback, MacWhisper 14.1 has rolled out with several fixes and refinements for the new editor. Version 14.1 also adds Gladia as a cloud transcription provider, and users can use their own Gladia API key to perform transcriptions.

MacWhisper 14 also includes:

重新設計嘅 AI 服務畫面，更加清晰易用 更新咗各大供應商嘅 AI 模型 同時開啟多份轉錄時嘅播放體驗有所提升 轉錄視窗有所改良，包括更佳嘅 Cmd+A 行為同即時編輯互動 Deepgram 嘅改進，包括歐盟／美國地區選擇、填充詞控制，以及擴充 Nova 3 嘅語言支援 雲端轉錄上傳唔再需要將整個檔案載入記憶體 修正咗選單列位置、音訊／影片拖動條同步、閒置時嘅 CPU 用量，以及會議錄製嘅邊緣情況

MacWhisper Pro users can upgrade to version 14 for free. Bruin is also offering a 14% discount for users who want to upgrade to Pro.
